title: Automatizacija, efikasnost i AI u SecOps-u
title_en: Automation, efficiency, and AI in SecOps
summary: Playbook i runbook, SOAR i IaC, obogaćivanje, tuning alarma i dashboardi, integracije kroz API, webhook i plug-in, te AI u SOC-u: slučajevi upotrebe, rizici (halucinacije, izlaganje podataka, trovanje modela, prompt injection) i governance.
summary_en: Playbooks and runbooks, SOAR and IaC, enrichment, alert tuning and dashboards, integrations via API, webhook, and plug-in, and AI in the SOC: use cases, risks (hallucinations, data exposure, model poisoning, prompt injection), and governance.
